propositions: GreenHopper provisions Epic Link and Epic Name fields only when the first Jira Software project is created, not at plugin startup
The session-start readiness gate waited for Epic fields before any project existed, creating an ordering deadlock that no budget could satisfy
The root cause is ordering (action precondition), not timing: 600s and 1800s budgets expired with identical inventories while the container remained idle after full startup
The fix moves the Epic-field check from session start to after project creation in _assert_project_capabilities, and reduces the budget from 600s to 120s based on measured 0.0512s provisioning time
The decision rule in not_ready_message claiming budget insufficiency is self-confirming and misleading; it misdiagnoses instances with no projects as instances with plugins still starting
